transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I... well, I came in because I've been hearing things. Voices. It's like... like someone is standing right there in my studio apartment. They say my name. They keep telling me my work is being judged. But... it's quiet. There's nobody else there.
How long have you been hearing these voices?
A while. Um... maybe about nine months. Since I started hearing them. And... having those feelings about my work being watched. Nine months, I guess.
During these past nine months, have you experienced any periods where your mood was extremely low or unusually high and energetic?

I... yes. A few months ago, I was... I had a lot of energy. I was only sleeping maybe two or three hours a night. I had these big plans for my art, and... combining it with my caregiving work. But even then, when I was moving so fast, I was still hearing them in the apartment. Still feeling like... like they were watching everything I did.
Looking back at the entire nine-month period, would you say that you spent more of your time feeling that high, energetic mood, or more of your time feeling like your mood was generally stable?

I... mostly not stable, I guess. For most of that stretch, I was just... wound up. You know, with the big plans, hardly sleeping... just always doing things. And then... even when I was coming down from all that, I still wasn't back to myself. So... yeah. Not a lot of normal time.
Are there any stretches of time within these nine months where your mood felt completely back to normal, yet the voices were still there?

Yeah... I suppose. After all that energy dropped and... I started sleeping regular again. There was a few weeks in there. The voices were still going. And... I still knew people were tracking my work. Judging me. It didn't stop just because I was sleeping.
During those few weeks when your mood felt back to normal, were the voices and the feeling that you were being watched still present throughout that entire time?

Yeah... like I just said. After the energy dropped off and I was sleeping normal again... they didn't stop. It went on for a few weeks like that. The voices... and just knowing people were judging and tracking my work. It was all still there the whole time.
During those few weeks when your mood felt back to normal, were you experiencing any other symptoms, like feeling extremely sad, hopeless, or having a total lack of energy?
No. I wasn't sad or... anything like that. Just regular. Except for the other stuff.

Looking back over the entire nine months, would you say that the time you spent feeling that high, energetic mood was relatively brief compared to the total amount of time you have been dealing with these voices?

Not really... no. It was most of the time. I was... just going and going. Barely sleeping, trying to get all my plans done. And when I wasn't doing that, I was still... off. It was mostly like that. Not brief.

During the entire nine months, were there any periods of at least two weeks where you experienced these voices and the feeling of being watched while your mood was stable, without any high or low energy episodes?

I thought I... I already said this. Yeah, there was a time. After the energy went away and my sleep was normal. The voices were still there... and I still knew people were tracking me. It lasted a few weeks like that.

During those few weeks when your mood was back to normal and you were still hearing voices, were you having any other symptoms, like a loss of interest in things you usually enjoy or trouble focusing on your daily tasks?
I don't think so. I was just... working. Going to work. I didn't notice anything else. Just the voices.

Aside from the voices and the feeling that you are being watched, have you noticed that your speech has become difficult for others to follow, or have you found it hard to keep up with basic tasks like personal hygiene or cleaning your apartment?

My speech is fine. I keep myself clean. But... I guess at work, on my client visits... sometimes things get a little hard to finish. 

I'll just stop what I'm supposed to be doing. I get caught up... lining things up. Like the medical gloves, or the little pill cups... even scraps of crochet yarn. I just put them in patterns. Or sometimes I'll just stand out in the hallway staring. Just... waiting for some kind of signal, I guess. I don't know.
